senses.gloss: घोर r. 1st cl. (घोरति) To go as a horse.

घोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frightful, horrible, terrific.
 m. (-रः) A name of
SHIVA.
 f. (-रा) Night.
 n. (-रं)
 1. Horror, horribleness.
 2. Poison. E.
घुर् to be frightful, affix अच or गुर् substituted for हन् to injure or
kill, and अच् Uṇādi aff.

घोरदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Terrific, of horrid or frightful appearance.
 m.
(-नः) An owl.
 E. घोर as above, and दर्शन sight.

घोरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Bellmetal.
 E. घोर and पुष्प a flower.

घोररासन m. (-नः) A jackal.
 E. घोर frightful, and रासन cry or sound,
from रास् to sound, affix ल्युट.
घोररासिन् m. (-सी) A jackal. E. See the last, णिनि aff.

घोररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Frightful, hideous.
 n. (-पं) A hideous. appearance.
E. घोर and रूप form.

घोररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Frightful, horrible, hideous.
 E. घोररूप and
णिनि aff.

घोरसङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Dreadful, horrible.
 E. घोर, and सङ्काश like.

घोराकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Frightful, hideous, of horrible aspect or
form.
 E. घोर, and आकृति form.
